strings: #20Ahoy! Nice of you to show up for the party. We need cover!
#20Our rudder's gone! Can you pull us?
Move towards your ally's ship and press 0 to grapple onto it.
#20I thought we were sunk! Thanks for your help!
#20Some mines will explode more than once!
#20They just keep coming! Time to get crazy! CHARGE!
